description_en: Queries the list of devices bound to an image search application instance
description_zh: 调用该接口，查询以图搜图应用实例绑定的设备列表
name: QueryPictureSearchDevices

parameters.description_en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call [QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~) to query instance ID.
parameters.description_zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用[QueryPictureSearchApps](~~206608~~)查询。
parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the image search application instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html to query instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 以图搜图应用实例ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/206608.html查询
parameters.name: app_instance_id

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10.
parameters.description_zh: 每页显示的条数。最小值为1，最大值为50，默认值为10。
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数。最小值为1，最大值为50，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.description_en: The page number to return. Pages start from page 1.
parameters.description_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序。
parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。页数从1开始排序
parameters.name: current_page
